abilities.name: Smart Step Backwards
abilities.text: A fighter can make this reaction after they have been allocated the total damage points by a melee attack action. This fighter makes a bonus disengage action.

abilities.name: Death Grip
abilities.text: After this fighter's next melee attack action in this activation, if at least 1 hit roll from that attack action results in a hit, the target forfeits 1 of their actions in this battle round. If the target has already activated or if they have no more actions to forfeit, allocate 3 damage points to the target instead.

abilities.name: Hunting Pack
abilities.text: Pick a friendly fighter with the Wildercorps Hunters faction runemark within 2" of this fighter. That fighter makes a bonus attack action that must target an enemy fighter within 2" of this fighter.

abilities.name: Hunter's Eye
abilities.text: Until the end of this fighter's activation, add 1 to the damage points allocated to enemy fighters by each hit and critical hit from attack actions made by this fighter.

abilities.name: Kill!
abilities.text: Pick a visible enemy fighter. Allocate a number of damage points to that enemy fighter equal to three times the number of friendly fighters with both the Wildercorps Hunters faction runemark and the Beast runemark within 3" of them.

abilities.name: Trailblazer's Might
abilities.text: Until the end of this fighter's activation, attack actions made by this fighter score a critical hit on a roll of 5+.

abilities.name: Regroup!
abilities.text: Each visible friendly fighter with the Wildercorps Hunters faction runemark within 6" of this fighter can make a bonus move action or a bonus disengage action (some can make a bonus move action and others can make a bonus disengage action).

abilities.name: Point Blank Volley
abilities.text: Once per battle round, before a friendly fighter this with battle trait makes a missile attack action, you can have them make a point blank volley. When they do so, you can treat the minimum range of that weapon as 1".
